## [1.3.0](https://github.com/tokudai-vs/tokudai-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-22)

### ✨ New Features

* **mygate:** add support for version 7.41.0 ([0d9fb88](https://github.com/tokudai-vs/tokudai-patches/commit/0d9fb8890b4bd662937eeeff8eb96224604f92c0))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **mygate:** fix AppTarget parameter syntax in Constants.kt and bump-version.py ([531cdb4](https://github.com/tokudai-vs/tokudai-patches/commit/531cdb4ac58cc84c79f23377a8d794a9bd7c03ba))

patches.name: Clean up Settings page
patches.description: Removes plan info, referral cards, cancellation links, and blank dividers from the Settings screen.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Enables push notifications, gate approvals, and e-Intercom on re-signed APKs using MicroG-RE (GmsCore).

options.description: The package name of the MicroG-RE / GmsCore build.

patches.name: Hide bottom navigation bar
patches.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar and expands the main view full screen.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes banner ads, sponsored cards, ad SDK loaders, and neutralizes the VIP crown icon.

patches.name: Remove home screen bloat
patches.description: Hides community posts from the home screen and filters unused shortcuts from Quick Actions.
